## Problem

What behavior is unclear, inconsistent, or missing?

## Proposed improvement

Describe the change and the expected result.

## Evidence or example

Include a reproducible example, report excerpt, or source links when available.

## Compatibility

Does this preserve the fixed Part 0-VII shell and incident-adaptive sections?
